program.section_heading: Theatre Arts Associate in Arts for Transfer (A.A.-T)
outcomes: Collaboratively create theatrical productions that effectively use theatre tools, techniques, and processes.
Utilize basic theatre vocabulary to effectively communicate the aspects of the art form to an audience.
Critique a theatrical production and play text in terms of dramatic structure, aesthetic choices, and production and performance quality.
Understand and articulate the evolution of theatre, with its variety of artistic styles and genres, relating them to contemporary global issues, values, and concerns.
